summary: The registrant, 21Shares Ethereum Staking ETF, filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Benchmark Licensing Agreement with FTSE International Limited and Amendment No. 2 to the Sponsor Agreement. The benchmark change, effective August 27, 2026, replaces the CME CF Ether-Dollar Reference Rate with the FTSE Ethereum Index for NAV calculation. The sponsor fee timing changes from weekly to at least quarterly in arrears. These are routine operational and contractual updates for an ETF, not a special situation.
